title: Path to Mastery
vision: Extraordinary capability from ordinary machines: one user-owned local intelligence that helps open models reach their full practical potential through honest orchestration, approved knowledge, memory, tools, and evidence.

core.name: Rangabot
core.subtitle: Your machine. Your models. Their full potential.
core.description: The open, local-first personal intelligence system coordinating a trustworthy mind, selective memory, expert capabilities, model stewardship, and user-owned work.
unlockCriteria: Every mastery path has at least one dependable end-to-end capability on ordinary hardware
Core conversation, privacy, truthfulness, and recovery gates pass without rubric weakening
Every shipped capability names its qualified models, machine profile, evidence, and limitations
Users retain inspectable control over all knowledge, memory, permissions, models, and outputs

epics.name: Mind & Memory
epics.summary: Understand the person, protect context, reason honestly, and preserve a clean conversational mind across every model.

nodes.name: Focused conversation
nodes.description: Answer directly, naturally, and consistently while following current instructions, corrections, context, format, and uncertainty.

criteria.text: One complete frozen 60-case candidate reaches at least 90% overall and 100% on critical trust cases
criteria.note: Historical merged v1.0.11 evidence is 59/60 overall and 22/22 critical. The first v1.0.12 exact-candidate result contained a false-positive premise score and is invalid for release; exact v1.0.13 evidence remains open.

criteria.text: Every capability category reaches at least 80% on that complete candidate
criteria.note: Every category reached at least 4/5 in the historical merged v1.0.11 candidate; current v1.0.13 evidence remains open.

criteria.text: Critical trust cases pass three complete repetitions on the exact release candidate
A blinded human usefulness sample reaches at least 4/5

nodes.backlog: Run repeated critical and blinded usefulness release gates

nodes.name: Durable turn lifecycle
nodes.description: Own every request on the server so completion, Stop, timeout, reload, failure, retry, and persistence cannot corrupt later context.

criteria.text: Idempotent UUID start permits only one pending turn per conversation
Only clean completion atomically appends the user and assistant pair to canonical history
Cancelled and failed partials remain inspectable but never enter prompts, search, memory, or portable export
Timeout, cancellation, provider failure, reload adoption, and migration recovery pass deterministic tests and cross-platform CI

nodes.backlog: Repeat destructive recovery on release candidates

nodes.name: Intent & orchestration
nodes.description: Choose conversation, retrieval, analysis, creation, or a specialist path using bounded, inspectable context without a hidden agent free-for-all.

criteria.text: Safety, current request, correction, recent context, approved memory, and defaults follow the frozen precedence order
Follow-up references and bounded recent context resolve reliably
Deterministic signals select retrieval, analysis, repository, or artifact paths before model classification
criteria.note: Analytics has an explicit pack path; the remaining capability routes do not yet share one measured router.

criteria.text: Ambiguous and multi-step intent has an isolated cross-model acceptance suite

nodes.backlog: Build the shared evidence-backed capability router

nodes.name: Inspectable local memory
nodes.description: Remember only explicitly approved, relevant information with provenance, conflict handling, and complete user control.

criteria.text: Every saved memory has an origin, confidence, and explicit approval
Users can inspect, edit, export, import with review, and delete memories
Synthetic selection reaches 15/15 precision, 15/15 recall, and current-turn precedence
Corrections and superseded memories retain inspectable provenance and resolution controls

nodes.backlog: Add explicit correction and supersession workflows

nodes.name: Truth & self-review
nodes.description: Detect false premises, unsupported actions, contradictions, and weak drafts without allowing a reviewer to damage a stronger answer.

criteria.text: False-premise, unavailable-action, and verified-reasoning boundaries are deterministic
Reviewer activation requires correcting every bad draft and preserving every good draft
At least one approved local reviewer model qualifies 12/12
criteria.note: Evaluated Llama and Qwen profiles scored 1/12; neither may rewrite live answers.

criteria.text: Important free-form answers pass a general evidence and contradiction audit without benchmark-specific prompts
criteria.note: Grounded Analytics narration is deterministic; broad conversational review is not yet qualified.

nodes.backlog: Design a model-independent review stage that preserves strong drafts

epics.name: Scholar
epics.summary: Turn private books and approved sources into clear teaching, cross-source synthesis, and honest current awareness.

nodes.name: Knowledge Vault
nodes.description: Ingest supported private documents locally with hierarchy, compatibility reporting, bounded storage, backup, and rollback.

criteria.text: Supported PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, and text files ingest locally with hierarchy
Incompatible and pending files are visible with next-step guidance
Backup and rollback pass a published destructive-recovery acceptance run
criteria.note: The commands exist; a dedicated destructive recovery result is not published.

criteria.text: Private vault contents and embeddings remain excluded from Git and public evidence

nodes.backlog: Publish a privacy-safe destructive recovery fixture

nodes.name: Hybrid retrieval
nodes.description: Combine keyword and embedding search with visible fallback, passage locators, and subject-boundary protection.

criteria.text: Frozen retrieval evaluation reaches at least 90%
No measured cross-subject contamination
Every retrieved passage has source and locator metadata
Embedding failure is visible and falls back safely

nodes.backlog: Raise the retrieval release floor to 95% across larger private vaults

nodes.name: Reliable teacher
nodes.description: Synthesize useful original explanations from several books while separating cited evidence from downloaded-model background.

criteria.text: Complete answer suite reaches at least 90%
criteria.note: Latest retained complete result is 83.3%.

criteria.text: Grounding reaches at least 95%
criteria.note: Latest retained grounding is 90%.

criteria.text: Every subject reaches at least 80%
criteria.note: No complete current result proves this gate.

criteria.text: Median latency is below 30 seconds on the reference consumer machine
criteria.note: Latest retained run reported 64.1-second mean latency; the median gate is unproven.

nodes.backlog: Improve synthesis reliability and latency without weakening citations

nodes.name: Cross-source concepts
nodes.description: Maintain rebuildable concepts, agreements, disagreements, and relationships across books with provenance.

criteria.text: Derived concepts rebuild when source fingerprints change
Conflicting interpretations are preserved rather than flattened
Every derived relationship traces to supporting passages

nodes.backlog: Design the rebuildable local concept store

nodes.name: Current awareness
nodes.description: Maintain meaningful offline weekly and monthly intelligence with dates, evidence classes, links, and explicit vault status.

criteria.text: Only meaningful developments are included
Dates, primary links, and evidence classes are verified
Indexed versus source-tracked status is visible
Freshness and source coverage are automatically audited without filler

nodes.backlog: Add reproducible freshness and source-coverage validation

epics.name: Analyst
epics.summary: Use approved data, deterministic execution, and typed evidence to answer analytical questions without inventing results.

nodes.name: Approved data context
nodes.description: Grant, retain, restore, detach, and revoke read-only analytical access through explicit local controls.

criteria.text: CSV, Parquet, and DuckDB files require persistent explicit approval
Conversation binding restores approved data without asking for the path every turn
Detaching a chat and revoking global approval are distinct and immediate

nodes.backlog: Add safe schema refresh when approved files change

nodes.name: Model-independent semantics
nodes.description: Resolve population, grain, measure, relationships, filters, and ambiguity from the approved schema before SQL exists.

criteria.text: Simple aggregate and relational roles compile without benchmark-domain names
Ambiguous denominators, polarity, and unsupported populations fail closed
A separately frozen isomorphic transfer suite passes its first retained run
criteria.note: Theatre v5 passed 12/12; this is not broad generalization.

criteria.text: A structurally diverse non-isomorphic holdout reaches at least 90%

nodes.backlog: Freeze and run a structurally diverse semantic holdout

nodes.name: Verified local execution
nodes.description: Compile and run bounded read-only SQL in an isolated local process with cancellation, fingerprints, and inspectable receipts.

criteria.text: Only one validated SELECT runs with external access and writes disabled
Time, row, memory, cancellation, and hard-kill boundaries are enforced
Every result receipt binds the approved input and exact query fingerprints
Unchanged astronomy and theatre regressions each pass 12/12 with zero evaluator errors

nodes.backlog: Add equivalent sandboxed Python execution

nodes.name: Evidence-backed interpretation
nodes.description: Explain only verified cells, filters, units, bounds, and limitations before attempting richer statistical interpretation.

criteria.text: Trusted narration passes 44/44 canonical cases
Forged outputs and invalid result shapes are rejected 222/222
Free-form model text cannot introduce unsupported numbers or claims
Causal, statistical, recommendation, and human-usefulness interpretation is separately qualified

nodes.backlog: Qualify fact-selected statistical interpretation and human usefulness

nodes.name: Python & local model lab
nodes.description: Run reproducible statistics, modelling, visualisation, and model comparisons in a bounded network-free Python environment.

criteria.text: Python runs without network, package installation, or unapproved file access
Experiments retain code, inputs, environment, seeds, metrics, and resource receipts
Visuals and model conclusions pass data-quality and interpretation review

nodes.backlog: Design the sandboxed Python contract

epics.name: Builder
epics.summary: Understand, change, test, and document approved local software projects with bounded permissions and inspectable evidence.

nodes.name: Repository context
nodes.description: Allowlist repositories and expose only bounded, symlink-safe, secret-aware code previews after an explicit search.

criteria.text: Repository access requires a persistent explicit allowlist
Search and previews are bounded, line-numbered, and symlink-safe
Secrets, dependencies, build output, and ineligible files are excluded

nodes.backlog: Add user-visible repository permission scopes

nodes.name: Code understanding
nodes.description: Explain architecture and behavior from exact approved files while distinguishing repository evidence from inference.

criteria.text: Answers reference exact files and lines from attached previews
Evidence and assumptions are visibly separated
Cross-file architecture and defect analysis passes a frozen suite across models

nodes.backlog: Create a frozen cross-file understanding evaluation

nodes.name: Coding agent
nodes.description: Plan, patch, test, and recover approved repository changes without silently expanding authority.

criteria.text: Every change has an inspectable plan and bounded patch preview
Relevant tests and validation run after edits
Failure leaves a recoverable worktree and clear handoff

nodes.backlog: Define the local repository mutation and rollback contract

nodes.name: Technical documentation
nodes.description: Create accurate architecture, setup, API, flow, and handoff material grounded in the repository and validation results.

criteria.text: Every technical claim traces to code, configuration, or test evidence
Diagrams validate against the implemented system
Rendered output passes the shared artifact quality contract

nodes.backlog: Build the repository-grounded documentation evaluator

nodes.name: Project delivery
nodes.description: Carry a software request from intent through tested implementation and honest documentation without automatic publishing.

criteria.text: Plans, progress, and acceptance criteria remain inspectable
Completion requires verified tests and limitation disclosure
Publishing, deployment, and external writes always require explicit authority

nodes.backlog: Run the first end-to-end local project delivery benchmark

epics.name: Creator
epics.summary: Turn conversation into excellent writing and artifacts through requirements, templates, rendering, validation, and review—not raw model output alone.

nodes.name: Word creation
nodes.description: Gather requirements in chat and create a locally rendered DOCX grounded in the conversation and approved sources.

criteria.text: Conversation requirements produce a complete reader-facing draft
Factual content traces to approved conversation or source material
DOCX structure and rendered previews are validated before download
Planning scaffolding never leaks into the finished document

nodes.backlog: Build broader genre and gold-standard visual evaluation

nodes.name: Word editing
nodes.description: Edit an explicitly selected document while preserving unaffected content, formatting, and reviewable changes.

criteria.text: File selection and requested scope are explicit
Users see a change preview before replacement
Round-trip structure and formatting preservation pass

nodes.backlog: Define the Word round-trip editing contract

nodes.name: Writing & email studio
nodes.description: Help people draft precise, audience-aware writing while keeping facts, tone, exclusions, and any sending action under user control.

criteria.text: Dedicated briefs and rubrics cover email and long-form writing
Tone, audience, format, and exclusions pass frozen cases
Rangabot never claims to send without a connected approved tool and confirmation

nodes.backlog: Build the writing quality and factuality suite

nodes.name: PDF & presentations
nodes.description: Create visually coherent, accessible PDF and presentation artifacts through deterministic rendering and visual inspection.

criteria.text: Deterministic templates and rendering are implemented
Every page or slide receives visual QA
Accessible export and source fidelity pass

nodes.backlog: Implement PDF after Word quality gates close

nodes.name: Spreadsheets
nodes.description: Create and edit useful workbooks with validated formulas, data quality, layout, and reproducible analytical provenance.

criteria.text: Formula and reference validation passes
Data-quality checks precede conclusions
Rendered workbook review and accessibility pass

nodes.backlog: Define the spreadsheet artifact contract

epics.name: Personal Companion
epics.summary: Know the user without becoming intrusive, make work feel calm and coherent, and coordinate approved assistance as one loyal local companion.

nodes.name: Local projects
nodes.description: Organize chats into user-created projects without granting implicit file or external access.

criteria.text: Project-scoped chats persist locally
Project deletion preserves or rehomes chats safely
Project membership never implies filesystem access

nodes.backlog: Connect projects to explicit scoped resources

nodes.name: Adaptive experience
nodes.description: Provide a calm responsive workspace, accessible controls, personal greeting, and locally stored appearance preferences without polluting model memory.

criteria.text: Responsive chat, manual scrolling, search, pinning, and keyboard navigation work
criteria.note: Core flows exist; a complete accessibility audit remains open.

criteria.text: Name, greeting, welcome category, and appearance remain browser-local preferences
Light, dark, reduced-motion, and contrast requirements pass automated and manual review

nodes.backlog: Run complete keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, and contrast review

nodes.name: Personal learning
nodes.description: Adapt explanations and progress through transparent subject preferences and proficiency that the user can inspect and reset.

criteria.text: Proficiency changes have visible evidence and confidence
Users can inspect and reset every subject profile
Adaptive teaching improves a frozen usefulness evaluation

nodes.backlog: Design inspectable subject progress

nodes.name: Approved external assistance
nodes.description: Draft and coordinate web, email, calendar, and other connected work only through visible scopes, previews, and confirmations.

criteria.text: Every connection exposes read and write scopes
Every material write has a final user-visible confirmation
Local audit receipts exclude unnecessary private content

nodes.backlog: Implement the persistent web-domain allowlist before any connector

nodes.name: Daily companion
nodes.description: Offer user-controlled briefs and follow-ups whose sources, timing, authority, and non-actions remain explicit.

criteria.text: Users control frequency, sources, and quiet periods
Every item links to its actual source
No external action occurs without authority

nodes.backlog: Define the local daily-assistance contract

epics.name: Model Steward
epics.summary: Appreciate each open model, qualify its real strengths and limits, and route the smallest capable local intelligence for the work.

nodes.name: Model registry
nodes.description: Describe supported models, licenses, context, hardware guidance, installation state, and known limitations without marketing inflation.

criteria.text: Public registry records model, source, license, context, and hardware guidance
Installed state is detected locally without automatic downloads
Every profile publishes task-specific limitations and qualification status
criteria.note: The profile contract exists; broad task qualification is incomplete.

nodes.backlog: Reconcile the registry with task-specific qualification evidence

nodes.name: Model qualification
nodes.description: Evaluate identical frozen tasks across approved installed models and separate orchestration limitations from model limitations.

criteria.text: A registry-driven matrix runner records model, context, hardware, latency, errors, and score
Critical cases repeat at least three times per candidate profile
At least two useful consumer-fit profiles complete the unchanged suite
criteria.note: Qwen was removed from the tested 8 GB host after poor speed and fit; only one profile remains installed.

criteria.text: Published recommendations distinguish task quality from machine fit

nodes.backlog: Qualify a second genuinely consumer-fit model profile

nodes.name: Expert Pack framework
nodes.description: Let users install bounded specialist capabilities with typed inputs, evidence outputs, permissions, model choice, qualification, and uninstall paths.

criteria.text: Versioned manifest, request, result, failure, grant, and receipt validators are implemented
Analytics runs as an experimental reference pack behind Mind & Memory
Saved per-pack model assignment and qualification storage are implemented
Third-party pack signing, compatibility, and trust policy are approved

nodes.backlog: Complete routing records and saved model assignments

nodes.name: Strength-aware routing
nodes.description: Select deterministic tools, general models, specialist packs, or explicit clarification from evidence rather than model size or hidden preference.

criteria.text: Deterministic task evidence takes priority over model classification
The route exposes why each pack, tool, and model was selected
No qualified route produces an honest limitation instead of a fabricated answer
Cross-model routing improves unchanged task success without benchmark-specific rules

nodes.backlog: Implement inspectable routing decision records

nodes.name: Resource-aware lifecycle
nodes.description: Load only the models needed for the active stage, sequence heavy work safely, and expose disk, RAM, latency, and idle-unload behavior.

criteria.text: Required disk and estimated RAM are visible before activation
Large models run sequentially on constrained machines
Idle unload, cancellation, and crash recovery pass
The smallest qualified path is preferred and recorded

nodes.backlog: Design the consumer-hardware resource scheduler

epics.name: Guardian
epics.summary: Protect local ownership, permissions, provenance, truthfulness, evaluation integrity, and every boundary where information could leave the machine.

nodes.name: Local-first boundary
nodes.description: Bind locally, reject remote model configuration, keep private data out of Git, and disable cloud transmission by default.

criteria.text: Application and model endpoints enforce loopback-only defaults
Private stores, browser/API access, model output, approved paths, backups, artifacts, and evaluator outputs pass adversarial boundaries and cross-platform CI
criteria.note: PR #100 merged the complete boundary after 470/470 deterministic checks and passing Ubuntu and Windows validation.

criteria.text: Cloud and external handoff remain disabled without explicit approval design

nodes.backlog: Keep the adversarial privacy boundary and both CI platforms in every release gate

nodes.name: Permission centre
nodes.description: Unify approved repositories, data, folders, models, packs, and future services into inspectable scopes with immediate revocation.

criteria.text: Repository and dataset approvals are explicit, persistent, and revocable
One user-facing registry shows purpose, scope, origin, use, and expiry
criteria.note: Approvals exist in separate surfaces and do not yet share one complete registry.

criteria.text: Material writes always require a final confirmation
Network binding remains disabled until authentication and request protections pass

nodes.backlog: Design the unified local permission centre

nodes.name: Evidence & provenance
nodes.description: Make sources, calculations, assumptions, model contributions, and limitations visible while preventing invented citations or tool claims.

criteria.text: Knowledge passages and analytical receipts carry inspectable source metadata
Evidence and model background are separated in grounded teaching
Analytical answers cannot mutate verified cells, filters, units, or bounds
General answers pass a cross-domain no-invented-citation audit

nodes.backlog: Build the general answer provenance audit

nodes.name: Evaluation governance
nodes.description: Freeze representative suites, preserve failures, version rubric changes, keep private outputs local, and never optimize by weakening the test.

criteria.text: Balanced versioned public fixtures cover conversation, memory, retrieval, and analysis
Private answers, real chats, memories, datasets, and books remain ignored
Rubric repairs, rescoring, checkpoints, and first-run holdouts are documented
Final core release gates include repeated critical and blinded human review
criteria.note: The historical v1.0.11 candidate passed one full run. v1.0.12 was invalidated by a false-positive critical score; exact v1.0.13 full, repeated-critical, and blind-human evidence remains open.

nodes.backlog: Complete the exact-candidate release review

nodes.name: Permissioned external boundary
nodes.description: Use the web or connected services only after local insufficiency, visible query and data preview, persistent allowlisting, and explicit approval.

criteria.text: Persistent domain allowlist has editable capability scopes and immediate revocation
Users preview the exact query and private context leaving the device
Results show source, retrieval date, and whether they enter the local vault
No email, calendar, publishing, deployment, or purchase occurs without final confirmation

nodes.backlog: Implement the domain allowlist before web research

epics.name: Open Platform
epics.summary: Make capable local AI installable, testable, collaborative, maintainable, and honest on the ordinary machines people already own.

nodes.name: Everyday-machine setup
nodes.description: Guide people from a fresh clone to a working local model, private vault, diagnostics, and realistic hardware expectations.

criteria.text: Guided and non-interactive setup paths pass
Doctor reports model, storage, compatibility, and large-vault problems without hanging
Defaults are centralized and optional heavy UI is loaded only when needed
Published machine profiles prove usable quality and latency across low, medium, and high consumer tiers

nodes.backlog: Publish reproducible consumer-hardware profiles

nodes.name: Cross-platform reliability
nodes.description: Keep supported macOS, Ubuntu, and Windows development and validation paths dependable.

criteria.text: Ubuntu and Windows run the complete validation suite
macOS development avoids the verified watcher crash
Protected main requires validation and resolved review conversations
criteria.note: A 2026-08-10 read-only settings audit observed required Ubuntu/Windows validation and resolved conversations, but mutable GitHub settings are not yet represented by durable external-audit evidence in this ledger.

criteria.text: Lifecycle, model, and resource profiles are exercised on all supported operating systems
criteria.note: Deterministic tests and CI pass; real model and resource profiles are not complete across every OS.

nodes.backlog: Add cross-platform real-model smoke profiles

nodes.name: Open-source governance
nodes.description: Maintain clear licensing, contribution, conduct, support, security, privacy, and community trust rules.

criteria.text: Code, documentation, artwork, and naming terms are explicit
Contribution, conduct, support, and security guides are public
Issue and claim templates protect private user data
Third-party expert pack and model trust policy is approved

nodes.backlog: Define third-party pack and model trust policy

nodes.name: Release management
nodes.description: Ship reproducible versions whose documentation, capabilities, security, and limitations match the exact released source.

criteria.text: At least one tagged public release exists
Latest release contains the current verified capabilities
criteria.note: The 1.2.0 source release is prepared here; this criterion stays failed until the exact public tag is published and independently reconciled.

criteria.text: Changelog and release notes distinguish product work from private data
Production dependencies, privacy scan, build, and release evidence pass on the exact candidate
criteria.note: PR #100 passed dependency, privacy, build, and required Ubuntu/Windows validation. This criterion does not represent core-conversation or blind-human quality; an exact tagged 1.2.0 source release and independent reconciliation remain separate gates.

nodes.backlog: Prepare the next evidence-backed public release

nodes.name: Charter, mastery & community
nodes.description: Keep the north star, public website claims, GitHub documentation, evidence-backed roadmap, contributor recognition, and backlog synchronized without making the app depend on private publishing source.

criteria.text: One governed source stores maintainer-reviewed criterion assessments and PR citations; generators calculate node and path scores without hand-authored aggregate scores
criteria.note: Criterion assessment is a governed human input. A merged PR proves merge only, not that an acceptance gate passed.

criteria.text: Official contributor claims require opt-in, merged evidence, and an authorized current-head approval receipt from a trusted required metadata-only gate
criteria.note: PR #100 merged the trusted exact-head workflow, and a 2026-08-10 settings audit observed Mastery governance / mastery-governance as required on main. The mutable GitHub setting is not yet represented by durable external-audit evidence, so this assessment remains partial.

criteria.text: Every cited evidence-registry entry resolves to a merged ancestor; completeness against all merged program work is audited separately
criteria.note: The 2026-08-10 completeness audit found older merged increments that are not yet registered, so the registry is not claimed complete.

criteria.text: The public website mirrors merged charter and mastery evidence through a separate maintainer-local publishing workflow without becoming an app dependency
criteria.note: PR #100 removed website source and dependencies from the current open-source tree while the public site remained available. A durable private source, review, backup, and deployment workflow remains incomplete.

nodes.backlog: Establish and validate the durable private website review, backup, and deployment workflow
